title: The RefinedWeb Dataset for Falcon LLM: Outperforming Curated Corpora with Web Data, and Web Data Only

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the toxicity of documents within the pretraining dataset using the Perspective API to measure the cumulative proportion of toxic content, comparing it against other popular datasets like The Pile and C4.

Using a language identification classifier (fastText) to determine the distribution of languages in the dataset, and comparing these proportions against worldwide language speaker statistics to identify over-represented and under-represented languages.
